column5: Look: *(provisional)* clean, minimal, orthographic shapes.
References: none named.
View: 2D · Camera: side view; follows the player, still when the level fits the window. *(provisional)*
Two overlaid lives per level, with different walls, gaps and doors
Portals you walk through, showing the other life inside their frame
Blocks you carry through portals
Switches and doors that share a colour and a mark, with the link animated
Five levels, one idea each: shown safe, then used, then twisted
Unlimited undo and a restart key, both taught on the title
Forgiving jumps that can never skip a puzzle
A clear sound and the exit lighting the moment a room is solved
teleport like a portal between the lifes · in the slice
simple puzzles · in the slice
You stand in a bright room with an exit door in sight and a wall too tall to jump in the way.
Beside you is a glowing frame, and through it the same room shows in red, with no wall.
You walk in, the world turns red, you walk past where the wall was, step through a second frame, and you are back in colour on the far side.
The exit lights.
Level 2 opens with a block and a switch.
*(provisional)* Level 3, around minute three, brings the first real puzzle.
A switch in the colourful life needs a block that exists only in the red one, and the obvious portal puts it on the wrong side of a door.
No death and nothing lost: undo takes back any move and restart resets the room.
Levels 4 and 5 chain two crossings and combine the tricks already learned.
